body:
I created a `find` util function that uses the native `find` method if available, otherwise an implementation with `filter`.

I chose to keep the native one when available because it's optimized to return once the item is found (it doesn't go through all items).

If you're concerned about the `reduce` implementation which goes through all the items, we can refactor it with a basic loop.

Once this is merged, we can remove the `find` mention in the Browser support section of the documentation.
